Synopsis:
    Ukrainian drones struck six logistics hubs of Russian e-commerce giant Ozon across southern Russia between August 22–24, causing fires, injuries, operational halts and evacuations. Facilities in Makhachkala, Enem, Adygeya, Stavropol and Samara were affected. Ozon and major shareholder AFK Sistema saw share prices drop 12% and 13% respectively on the Moscow Exchange. Rival Wildberries had previously been targeted in similar attacks.
